name: Century Business Media Limited
about: Century Business Media Limited provides Out-of-Home (OOH) advertising services in digital and non-digital formats in Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, and the North Eastern states. It offers Airport Out-of-Home (AOOH) and Railway Out-of-Home (ROOH) advertising services that includes spaces within and outside airport terminal buildings; and digital and static hoardings across railway stations and railway land. The company also provides Metro Out-of-Home (MOOH) advertising, including advertisements on Platform Screen Doors (PSDs), and offers in-shop branding services. In addition, it offers various traditional city media formats, including hoardings, billboards, unipole, multipoles, pole kiosks, wall wraps, wall paintings, lollipops, gantries, in-shop branding, and other related media assets. The company serves corporate, non-corporate, government, and non-government organizations, including public sector undertakings, such as banking and financial services, insurance, education, healthcare, hosiery, jewellery, FMCG, oil and gas, power and energy, steel, mining, and infrastructure services sector; government departments, including tourism and communication agencies at the state and central levels; and advertising agencies, media buying firms, and marketing consultancies. Century Business Media Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in North 24 Parganas, India.
